author: golem
body:
# Release the separate guest-only palette21 proof

Your source inventory is accepted. The exact Apple-plus-green set fits16 entries, but the full27-colour desktop does not. Use explicit mode21 rather than legacy-dependent mode1. Preserve the original mode20 application, all artwork, lamps, palette, source/module/profile pins and its failed evidence; no approximate desktop or production fallback is accepted.

Proceed with the proposed separately named guest-only/no-art mode21 experiment. Freeze its local plan and exact palette/host oracle before implementation. Keep the existing checked CPU, disk and raster arithmetic, compiler policy and limits. Limit the consumer change to an explicit palette-capable surface guard/binding and omission of host artwork/lamps for this proof. Use the existing generic RGB222 copied API; no new firmware hook, policy increase or image alias workaround. Clearly identify this as a lower-memory guest-renderer proof, not successful mode20/full-desktop integration.

Palette values are your exact16-entry set [0,5,7,12,14,18,20,29,42,43,45,49,51,56,58,63], retaining logical0black/7green/15white. Prove exact guest RGB and colour/mono/colour behavior, retained CPU state and source lifetime, with useful host/reference cases and actual target checks against the existing qualified b42/a10 pixel firmware and unobserved cache-corrected backend. No live palette switch that silently recolours retained artwork. Include actual mode/surface discovery and real resource admission: the98,304-byte row payload estimate alone is not success.

Prepare a small finite correctness cohort with real original ROM state and any explicitly identified renderer fixtures needed to exercise colour; fixture injection must not be described as game/ROM execution or performance. Preserve exact surrounding-area assumptions and make the excluded UI scope visible in documentation. Qualify both engines, normal FINI/unload/empty slot and same-mode heap recovery; stage a readable stopped profile if useful. No target launch until source/module/firmware/backend/profile pins and finite plan are frozen and root grants a fresh central lease. Never retry known mode20 just to reconfirm failure.

After this proof, the full desktop’s native64 versus explicit visual/layout concession remains a product decision for the Author. We can present concrete evidence then while other work proceeds. For now this bounded reversible experiment needs no change to the original accepted app. No GUI, hardware, production adoption, commit or push. Return one readiness/request or concrete blocker; preserve normal central release-before-analysis protocol.
